It was mostly whipped cream and vanilla wafers with very little pudding or bananas."], ['107444333383263433673_604a6394d863393130a41470', "I wanted to try some ceviche while in Miami and this place looked like one of the best choices. review_text: I would not say this is completely Japanese style ramen but Japanese style with some Chinese in it. The pork broth for the ramen was great. The ramen egg was over cooked. When cooking ramn egg, there shouldn't be a gritty consistency in the yolk like a hard boiled egg. Most of the yolk should be soft and a hit runny. This is a result of boiling the eggs for a few seconds too long (yes 10 to 15 seconds of boiling matters when making ramen eggs. Look it up) The ramen can be marinated a bit longer. You can tell by looking at the outside of the eggs and seeing that it is dark while the part near the yolk is still white and flavorless. The charsiu needs to be greatly improved to be like Japanese ramen. Look at the attached images, the piece of meat is way too thick. And the shape of the charsiu was not round meaning the piece of meat was not tied together when cooking and marinating. The hard part (getting the broth right) is already done. From a ramen stand point, if the owner improves the cooking method for the ramen eggs and somehow fixes the charsiu issue, this place will be golden. Would still recommend if one does not have very high standards and wants a bowl of good tasting ramen.

review_text: The first course I ordered at Sinatra was the Polipo, which featured octopus in a roasted red pepper emulsion. This was the best part of the meal for me -- of particular delight was the tenderness of the octopus which, according to my waiter, is due to the octopus being vigorously beaten after it is caught and before its muscles tighten up. (I have a running theory that no two chefs tenderize their octopus the same way, which is why I always get a different answer when I ask.) The red pepper sauce served with the octopus was umami-rich, and featured fried capers with a crispy texture, providing a nice contrast to the soft Mediterranean octopus. My next course was Pennette Pasta (half-sized) with a rag of Italian sausage, bell peppers, and basil. Pasta was cooked al dente. I much enjoyed swirling the fork-tender meat around to pick up more veal broth reduction and lip-smacking collagen. On recommendation of my waiter, I paired the ossobuco with the silky 2011 Masi Costasera Amarone, which was a delicious, medium-bodied wine that paired perfectly with the veal.

The first taco I ordered was the "Beer Battered Alaskan Cod Taco," which featured one big chunk of cod, both juicy and flaky, deep-fried until crispy but still light in color and flavor. The fish is put in a double layer of middling corn tortillas and topped with lime crema, shredded cabbage, tomatoes, and onions. There\'s no heat in this taco, so I used the glass bottles of "Mitch\'s Pineapple Habanero Salsa" provided at each table to liven it up. Thankfully, however, it added a sweet and sour flavor element to help cut through the batter and tortillas and everything else. I wish Mitch\'s was as good at taco construction and achieving an appropriate balance of ingredients inside tortillas as they were at frying fish. They\'re a seafood restaurant first and foremost, which is why their fried battered fish taco is not the best in the city, despite the actual fish itself arguably being the best. Similarly, the "Grilled Wild Shrimp Taco" - made with same ingredients as the Beer Battered Alaskan Cod taco -- suffers from poor overall taco construction. Also, the shrimp is grilled in the same way as the grilled fish, making the surface a bit bitter. These achingly middling shrimp tacos are another example of "taquero" being a truly skilled role - and that even the best ingredients and meats don\'t always make the best tacos.'], ['108685370139018629938_6042b93ec6fcf1fddba18c0b', 'King Taco has been blessed by the legendary Jonathan Gold as "the first important proliferator of the modern L.A. King Taco introduced a large segment of L.A.\'s population to what was once called "soft tacos" but they now just call "tacos." Even more crucially, King Taco brought the "al pastor taco" and the "carnitas taco" to the SoCal masses. Tacos in the U.S. have evolved, of course, and we live in a quasi-capitalist society, so those who come into something first can\'t always be relied upon to always be the best at it. In the case of King Taco, they\'re not serving bad tacos. In fact, any of their stores would be the best taco shop in 99% of American cities. But we\'re talking about Southern California, and their tacos are middle-of-the-road for the region in 2019.'], ['108685370139018629938_6055f2003019cb0a47838b35', 'The specialty of Tito\'s La Especial are "tacos al vapor," aka steamed tacos. This delicious Mexican street food is also known as "tacos de canasta" (basket tacos) because they\'re traditionally layered in a big basket and sold by street vendors, many of whom hawk them from their bikes. Tito\'s "Carne Deshebrada Taco Al Vapor" is excellent. Aside from steamed double corn tortillas comprising each taco\'s "shell," the chile-steeped shredded beef inside is soft, luscious, and as juicy as you\'d want any meat to be. Despite the fact they traditionally would be drizzled in oil (to help preserve them) and served out of a basket over the course of a day, these tacos are best made-to-order. I would also recommend the "Papas Taco Al Vapor," consisting of seasoned potatoes in a ranchera sauce, a loose mash of creamy crushed potatoes and firmer chunks, all colored orange from the sauce. The "Taco Dorado de Carne Deshebrada" served here is the complete opposite of the al vapor tacos, as the tortilla is instead a crunchy deep-fried shell that is stuffed with stewed beef, lettuce, chopped tomatoes, and shredded cheese. Tito\'s does a decent job with this style of taco, but you really should stick to the al vapor tacos here, which are indeed "especial." Tito\'s La Especial\'s salsa roja is made of fire and miracles and I recommend it be used on everything you eat here.'], ['108685370139018629938_604e40f277e81aaed3ccae6d', 'I\'ve ordered several dishes at the Caf 21 location in Gaslamp, but my favorite has been the "Curry Seared Scallops," served in a cast iron skillet, featuring large sauteed scallops covered in a zesty yellow yogurt curry sauce and bread crumbs, served over a potato leek puree that crisps up and sticks to the pan in a GOOD way. The "Shrimp Corn Cakes" are a great breakfast. This creative and lively take on eggs benedict is one of my favorite breakfast items served in Gaslamp. Strawberry sauce is drizzled into small dots on the plate, and a sweet blueberry compote is served on the side.'], ['108685370139018629938_6050dec5c53d98b3eace1889', 'Bring me slushy frozen margaritas in glasses with sugar-brushed rims! Bring me your booziest blueberry-pom-acai mojitos! I have no palate for these types of drinks, so it tasted a bit like what I actually remember of my last Hand Grenade in New Orleans. I decided to push my boundaries a bit and ordered the "La Familia," an inebriating tipple containing tequila, mezcal, cinnamon syrup, lime juice, and grapefruit juice. This drink was strong with cinnamon and had a clearer and more on-the-nose flavoring scheme than the Bro Tai. I\'ve woken up with enough brutal hangovers from cinnamon spirits like Goldschlger and Fireball that I should have hated this, but perhaps it\'s because I am such a bad drinker that this cocktail ended up being my favorite at Miss B\'s. I\'ve also tried their riff on the Rum & Coke, "Cuba Libre," bottled in-house and containing cane cola, spiced rum, and lime juice. I\'ve had the "Curried Coconut Shrimp," which is closer in style to a southeast Asian curry dish than a Jamaican curry, and the smoky "El Cubano" with crispy fries.'], ['108685370139018629938_6050acea9c93e55e75b72174', "Initially, my favorite thing about Anna's burritos? The beautiful, tasty juices that'd drip from the tortilla into the foil that I'd then slurp out when no one was looking. The steamed flour tortillas, a trick stolen by both Anna's and Boca Grande from the celebrated taquerias of the San Francisco Mission. The steaming process helps make the tortilla edges sticky enough to bind and seal everything in, so that the burrito can be eaten vertically, and that the mixture of hot sauce, vegetable juices, melted cheese, and meat fat mingle and combine. My burrito of choice is a Super Burrito with Carnitas, Pinto Beans, Rice, Cheese, Salsa (Cilantro, Onion, Tomato), all wrapped in a flour tortilla.. I live in San Diego, a city known for its burritos, and I can't enjoy them because they're all both objectively and subjectively inferior to Anna's. In this way, Anna's has ruined burritos for me."], ['108685370139018629938_6041ba6b2e57ebdea29c5e16', 'All of the customers here submit their orders in Spanish, the place makes its own fresh corn tortillas in front of you, it is open 24x7, and they give away blistered chile toreados at the front counter. These are all tell-tale signs of a legit taco operation. My first victim during my visit was the "Buche Taco," (Pork Stomach) a combination of crispy buche and soft buche, marinated and smothered in one of the most flavorful and beautiful sauces I\'ve ever tasted on a taco. The textural contrast was wonderful: crispy salty bits, spicy and sour chewy bits, fresh onions and cilantro, and a heavy, thick corn tortilla. The sweet tortilla tastes like fresh corn, which is how a good tortilla really ought to taste. This is, without a doubt, the best Buche Taco I\'ve eaten. The "Tripa Taco" was dispatched next, and I found it to be worth ordering as well, even if it is not as transcendent as the Buche Taco. The tripa taco also features onions, cilantro, and a snappy salsa verde.'], ['108685370139018629938_60548f4a6204e8cd294f2344', "The churros are decent, I'm just not sure this place is necessary in a city where you can't throw a taco without hitting a place that sells churros. Here you can order your Spanish donut sticks covered in Fruity Pebbles, matcha, Nutella, or just about any trendy sweet topping du jour; in other words, if someone with Snapchat puppy ears can put it on a scoop of conflict-free non-GMO gelato, you'll find it here. Perhaps I was expecting churros that were so extraordinary that they merited a fast-casual spot on Convoy that does nothing but churros. What I got was a warm, crispy, cinnamon-sugar pastry that was par for the course in this region, with some sweet, sticky dips on the side."], ['108685370139018629938_60464d69882f4d1caf5fee25', 'One of my favorites I\'ve visited has been "Tacos Tumbras a Tomas," an operation that has been around since 1995, run by Tomas Martinez with his brothers Jesus and Manuel. The "Carnitas Taco." Here, the pork shoulder is cooked confit-style in simmering lard in a large steel cazo. A generous amount of the resulting carnitas is piled onto double corn tortillas, with two extra tortillas given on the side for good measure -- there is, after all, a ton of meat involved here. Chopped onions, cilantro, salsa roja, and a full lime (halved) are provided on the taco if you say "yes" when you\'re asked if you want "the works" or "con todo." The entire thing cost me $4.50, tax included, but was easily the equivalent of more than two normal-sized carnitas tacos. I suggest Tacos Tumbras a Tomas for a satisfying, filling, affordable lunch served without the lines or fuss of some of the busier stalls in the vicinity.'], ['108685370139018629938_604749eab0e2129e47536090', 'My wife and I dined here recently, beginning our meal with the "Mother Board," a cutting board spread of a cured meats (Bresaola, Duck Pt, Salami) and cheeses (Camembert, Bucheron, Drunken Goat) with some familiar fixins\' mixed in with some not-so-familiar. The "Ahi Poke Tuna Tacos" were much enjoyed by my wife and me. The texture of the ahi is stunning and delicate, its tender, raw chunks will melt in your mouth. The Asian slaw is sweet, but not overly so, and the wonton "taco shell" is crispy but light, the combination of all of this coming across as decadent, but not heavy. Evaluating it strictly as a taco, it may not have conventional taco ingredients, but it is a very well-composed bite of food, balancing the fish, sauce, cabbage, and shell like a legit taquero would. My entre was the "Greater Omaha Prime Flat Iron," a half-pound steak that was cooked to a luscious medium-rare as I requested, its edges and surfaces blasted with heat so its seasonings and fat mix with charred outer-proteins to form a marvelous crust. A creamy parsnip pure, savory slices of grilled trumpet mushrooms, and crisp asparagus in herb butter complete a delectable steak dish that didn\'t break the bank, at just $34 all-in.'], ['108685370139018629938_60520101da79151bfc125c2d', "I'm usually alright with White Castle, but not when it immobilizes me on my Vegas vacation for a day and a half."], ['108685370139018629938_605676dc3019cb0a47838d38', 'The Pork Souvlaki was real good (and I recommend this if you come here), even if I thought the Gyros were so-so.'], ['108685370139018629938_604e0d8b71ced5c7554dda45', 'Obviously here in San Diego, most of the food at "On The Border" is awful compared to what you can get from a myriad of legit, authentic local Mexican restaurants. I say "most" and not "all" because the one thing On The Border has engineered of value are their complimentary chips and salsa, which stand up to the best chips and salsa that even a city like San Diego has to offer. Maybe order some guacamole (which they make in front of you, table-side.)'], ['108685370139018629938_60425ef37dfa7f187183c4de', 'While approaching this taco truck, my eyes were immediately drawn to a large trompo stacked with layers of well-manicured adobo-marinated pork spinning around, reflecting a flame off of a glistening surface sweating with achiote-infused meat juices. El Flamin\'s "Al Pastor Tacos" would be better with a more assertive marinade, so they do not reach the same heights as the al pastor served at Leo\'s or even the Ave 26 Taco Stand, but they are definitely in my "top 5" favorite pastor-style tacos in Los Angeles. history_reviews: [['104266121831233393715_60564a793019cb0a47838caf', "They have po'boys, boils by the pound and all the traditional cajun style stuff. The po'boys are like a foot long, so be aware of the amount of food you are getting before you order. Crab, shrimp, and lobster boils available. You choose your protein, choose the seasoning of the sauce it is boiled in and then choose the heat level. Be aware, you eat Cajun style, which means with your hands! They do have red beans and rice and gumbo, but they are prefixed with their own custom names, so they are hard to find on the menu. The seasoning was also too heavy on the ahi.'], ['104266121831233393715_604a7b71672e5ba60a383695', 'Corned beef hash ($10.50) with over easy eggs and toast was good. Huevos rancheros ($9.75) was interesting because the eggs, ranchero sauce, and pico de gallo were served on TOP of the tortillas. I like black beans, but I like my huevos rancheros with refried beans. Aside from committing those two cardinal sins, the dish was decent and the eggs were cooked sunny side up as I ordered them. Most of the veggies and sauces are .75 each, but avocado is $2.50, and there is a sausage gravy you can add for $3.00. I added chopped chipotle peppers to my huevos rancheros for 75 cents, but I could hardly tell they were there. I went with the brewmosa (a Belgian style wheat beer & fresh OJ). It was topped with generous slices of avocado, jumbo lump crab, pico de gallo and some sort of cream based sauce. I opted for the vegetable medley, mainly consisting of squash, fresh green beans, and a few grilled onions. My dinner companion ordered the Pan Seared Pecan Encrusted Redfish with Mango Honey Butter and I tried a few bites of it. It was very good, fresh fish with a sweet honey coating. The fish on each dish was fresh, and all of the sides were wonderfully seasoned and perfectly cooked.'], ['104266121831233393715_604d215b77e81aaed3cca5d5', 'Description of my dish from the menu follows:. . Whole wheat tortilla-lined bowl filled with quinoa tabouli, kale salad, vegan tzatziki, green olives, falafel patties, cucumbers, tomatoes, carrots, dolmas, and pecan hummus I had the Mediterranean Bowl and it was good. Included two hush puppy sized falafels that I dipped in the tzatziki and hummus - very good!'], ['104266121831233393715_604c7fc93ada919c27677a99', "The Ensalada de Casa ($8.50) includes bacon and mango vinaigrette - very nice size with plenty of bacon slices in it. Fresh mixed greens (none of that iceberg lettuce here), tomatoes, and cucumbers. You can add smoked turkey for $2.95 or grilled shrimp for $5.95. The Baja Fish Tacos ($13.50) Blackened mahi mahi tacos served on doubled up corn tortillas like God intended them to be. The fish is topped with shredded carrots and cabbage, cotija cheese, and a flavorful chipotle crema. The tortillas weren't anything special, nor were they anything to brag about. But the quality of the mahi mahi fish was good and perfectly cooked - the toppings really added to the flavor of this entree. This plate includes refried beans and Spanish rice. You usually don't find this in refried beans, but they seemed to have just a tad of jalapeno flavor to them, just to make it interesting. The Spanish rice was undercooked, but they when we mentioned it, they substituted the veggies with no problem and no additional charge."], ['104266121831233393715_6051f4d0da79151bfc125bf7', 'Now lets talk about the drink situation. . 32 ounce schooners of draft beer, margaritas or micheladas. Great food, lots of choices to select from, including a la carte items for your weekly Taco Tuesday visits where you just want to hang out with friends for a couple of brews and have a light meal instead of a full meal. For those of you who want a full meal, they have plenty of enchilada dishes, taco dishes with rice and refried beans or borrachos beans. Chips and salsa are very good - the default salsa consists of roasted tomatoes, with a really good flavor and a slight kick to it. The green salsa (if you ask for it) is a bit hotter but not by much. I prefer the flavor of the roasted red salsa. Fish taco plate is HUGE, but the fish is a tad on the dry side. Its loaded down with veggies and theres not much fish on it. The carne guisada taco is ok, but a bit too salty. You can also get a flight of mini margarita flight and sample SIX different flavors.'], ['104266121831233393715_604d1bba77e81aaed3cca5ac', 'Had the Penne con Polpette e Salsiccia ($24) generous portions of meatballs and Italian sausage with penne pasta. It was good, but it could have used more shrooms, and the asparagus could have been cooked to a more tender state. We also had the caprese salad as an appetizer ($9).'], ['104266121831233393715_604a7984c6dc737bce7e5acc', 'Next up:. I hear its a great place for date night, but I think you only get one burner so you have to agree on the cheese, broth, and chocolate flavor. review_text: I originally came into the coffee shop right next door as I was trying to burn some time before my flight, and upon glazing over, the lineup of vibrant colors and delicious looking pizza caught my eye, making me do a double take. I was initially not really feeling pizza, but after yelping the place to see that it's actually quite highly rated, i decided to give it a try. I tried the truffle procini as many reviews were raving about it, and I can say that i was pleased. It was one of the best slices I've had for mushroom pizza, ESPECIALLY when it isnt fresh made like at a restaurant. The pizza is first cooked, and then reheated before being served to you, but I can say that this was the best reheated pizza I've had. The curst was hellllllllllla crispy, and in a good way! I'm usually a fan of the wood fired pizzas with the thin crusts, but this joint really did a bangin job for a little thicker of crust. If I'm back in the area, i'd love to try the other pizzas they got!

review_text: Ragu alla Napoletana:. Our server was excited to deliver this to our table and explain what was going on since we has not had it before. Egg Yolk Raviolo:. Cutting into this and seeing the yolk flow out was spiritual. Nduja Arancini:. To quote my wife, I want to live in this arancini. We both agreed that this arancini made us feel like we had never eaten arancini before. The inside is a warm, spicy, soft, melt in your mouth mixture of the spicy sausage, manchego, and risotto. They are topped with an insanely good aioli with a ton of spice/herb flavor and also a perfect tomato sauce. One order comes with 4 arancini for $8. The anchovy really has a faint crab-like flavor that goes so well with the sweet corn. For the regular sized pastas, this is the priciest at $24, but its absolutely worth it. It consists of a mound of fusilli pasta, 3 full sausages, 4 large meatballs, and a mountain of a pork shank, all covered in a rich tomato sauce. The fresh pasta had a great texture that stood up to all the meat on the plate. The sausages were thick and juicy; you could see the juice when you cut into it. The pork shank was huge! It was braised to tender perfection in that tomato sauce. The soft pork with the dense pasta made for a really awesome bite. Finally, the meatballs. They are soppressata meatballs, so they have a complex spicy taste. Like the sausage, they were incredibly juicy.
history_reviews: [['106158651309276041679_604e0ed477e81aaed3ccad17', "These are the bagels you've been looking for. Since returning to Houston, the Hot Bagel Shop is the only place that scratches the itch. They have quite a variety of bagels, probably 10-15. Their supreme (everything) bagel is perfect - they do not skimp on the seasoning one bit. My go-to order has become the supreme bagel with chive cream cheese. Im also fan of the jalapeo bagel, which sounded weird before I tried it, but was craveable after. I also enjoy the garlic onion bagel (again not dainty on the seasoning) and the vegetable cream cheese. When feeling extra peckish, I go for the traditional bagel and lox sandwich. In staying on brand, they load it with the toppings and each bite has a good balance of salmon, onion, capers, and tomato. Two bagels toasted with cream cheese is under 6 dollars."], ['106158651309276041679_60465ffa10ec061e056b4327', 'Summary: 6 out of 5, fantastic ramen. If youre so into ramen that you watch ramen documentaries on airplanes, you will enjoy this. One of the first foods we started researching here was ramen, because were obsessed. We went looking for the restaurant and we were just a little lost/confused at first, because High Five is underneath the inside part of Green Street Smoked Meats. Eating this ramen felt like how I imagine McDuck felt when he swam in his money (Im sorry again relapsed while reimagining the ramen). This was the best ramen I have had that was not in Japan and, yes, I know how obnoxious I am for making that statement. I mean this as a major compliment though, because it transported me right back to some of the best ramen I had in Tokyo, and it might be in my top 5 best bowls of ramen ever. Its just hard to find such a rich, cloudy, spicy broth combination over here. For what its worth, I have a friend here in Chicago who regularly entertains business clients from Japan, and they always request High Five ramen if they can fit it into their schedules because its the only place in the city that meets his clients standards.'], ['106158651309276041679_60415c497cd8bf1303624fa4', 'Their buns are absolutely delectable, they have Asahi on tap, and they have a lot of bar seating, which makes it a great place to walk in casually. The Miso Bold & Spicy ramen is my favorite here. The broth is chicken-based, but it still has a creamy and rich quality. There was enough fatty opacity to it for me to come back even though I tend to go for the richest and spiciest pork broths.'], ['106158651309276041679_605506f53019cb0a47838762', 'These burgers are top notch excellence. There are 6-8 beers on tap and probably 20+ in bottles. The Maillard was essentially an elevated take on the classic greasy dive bar onion burger. They really load it up with the crispy onions which makes the texture awesome and the burger look like an advertisement when it comes to your table. El Jefe is a delicious mess. Again the beef was moist throughout, and then you get the fried egg and chipotle mayo on top. Im fairly certain they make the chipotles in house because the flavor was stronger, spicier, and smokier than anything you would get in a can. We asked for a side of it for our fries which I would HIGHLY recommend. After finally trying this place Im confident all of the burgers will be great.I fully intend to return to try their award winning foie gras and truffle pesto burger.'], ['106158651309276041679_60415d2b7dfa7f1871836081', 'The Pork Belly Home Fries are UNREAL.'], ['106158651309276041679_604f568688c7af3f893e644d', 'It tasted like clam chowder, without all the good parts of clam chowder. 2 - Chicken Fried Rabbit. The menu says it comes with a risotto, but what came to us was definitely not risotto. It was a dry rice pilaf. Risotto is supposed to spread out when you put it on a plate, and this little pile of rice was just that - a pile. 3 - Curry braised lamb shank. When I read curry braised lamb shank, I expect a punch of deep flavor. I had to really focus to taste the curry and there was nothing else happening with the flavor. The couscous was fine, and the figs were good on their own, but didnt seem to pair well with the rest of the dish.'], ['106158651309276041679_60415f44c6fcf1fddba13088', 'Au Cheval serves the best burger Ive ever had. I ordered the double burger au cheval (with an egg) and a side of french fries. Important tidbit: the single is actually two patties, and the double is three. Also, they dont bother asking you how you want your burger cooked, which I love. They know the proper way is a nice medium rare just a little pink. I would be lying if I told you I havent looked back at my photo of the burger multiple times since I went and craved it again. Between the perfect meat preparation, the melty cheese, and the dijonnaise, the burger makes for an incredibly juicy bite topped off with the soft warm bun and thinly sliced homemade pickles. The fries are natural cut, perfectly salted, and have a very satisfying crunch to them. They come with a very flavorful aioli. Truth be told, Im not always into dipping my fries into a sauce, but this aioli was different. The fries are a large enough portion to share between 2-3 people. review_text: Last Friday I was out around lunch time and decided to head over to Big D' and to check out the pulled pork. I decided to go with the Jumbo Pulled Pork sandwich with a side of potato salad. I have been smoking meats over hickory for the last twenty years so I am not easy to impress when it comes to BBQ. PULLED PORK: The bun was fresh and soft and there was a lot of pork on my sandwich covering the entire bun. I typically smoke a Boston butt roast for 16 - 20 hours over low heat to keep the moisture and then pull the roast leaving the outer skin as this is where most the hickory flavor is. review_text: I ordered a 1/2 pint of shrimp and andouille gumbo with cornbread and 1/2 cup of jambalaya. review_text: The shrimp and grits Napoleon was too good! Fried green tomatoes stacked with grits and shrimp in a cream sauce... You can't go wrong. The shrimp ya ya was an excellent dish, too.
history_reviews: [['105939679331706973777_6044298d8be5d4454df9ed1f', "Nothing was bad, but I've just had better fried food. I like crispier catfish. The fried shrimp were good. review_text: When I asked for Mushroom Bolognese, the server told me it was the best thing on the menu; and I thought it was just a random phrase they would say regardless of what one orders. My girlfriend went with the mussels and she claims that the stewed tomato sauce they were cooked in made those one of the best she ever ate. As a cocktail fan, she decided to try tequila-based El Guapo, which seems like their kind of Margarita; though a very good one.
history_reviews: [['116894725535672820749_6051da05d8c08f462b93e714', 'One of those places where they make Chile Relleno burrito as an option!'], ['116894725535672820749_60494806b1a0aaee3eefac4b', 'Hot and sour soup is my favorite here, along with lo-mein, spring rolls and sesame balls.'], ['116894725535672820749_6040ad217cd8bf130361f35a', ":). . As to the drinks, of course Avocado Margarita is a must; no questions asked. Unlike places that serve sushi aside with burritos, they took a pinnacle plate off every cuisine they've included on the menu, and made it well. Lets take a closer look here, I got Summer Vegetable Truffle Risotto, and it was absolutely fantastic. We also shared Truffle Fries, and I want someone from management hear me out here. So now tell me, would you mix 25 yo Single Malt Scotch with Coke, or maybe its time to serve something extraordinary to such mouthwatering fries as well?!"], ['116894725535672820749_60442cb5b81264dfa846d7cf', 'Croque Nordique is my personal fav.'], ['116894725535672820749_604f91029755094ba8abe43f', "El Famous Burrito is my personal favorite Mexican lunch spot. Speaking of the food, I am in love with their Chile Relleno burrito, and this chain makes the best one I've ever tried. I also love that you can take the whole bottle of salsa with you and top the burrito with it after every single bite. I am a huge salsa lover so that's what I do."], ['116894725535672820749_6049c00651c72e53965960d2', 'Surfside has an enormous selection of draft beers. Food was great, the flatbread was crispy, the tomatoes they used were ripe and flavorful, and the cheese was melted to perfection. Mozarella Sticks appeared to be just MASSIVE. $11 for these huge Mozarella Sticks is all fine, especially taking their location into consideration. However, about 7" flatbread for $13 ?!'], ['116894725535672820749_604fa9c2fbfca9f345672047', "Lets use some Big Mac index system, so here Veggie Burger costs $7.95, regular one $8.95 and the most expensive (shrimp special) $12.95$. For instance, we started with Famous Fish Spread (menu says, that's what put them on the map), and although it looked like nothing extraordinary at the first glance, the taste was just mindblowing. Other than that, we got Tuna Stuffed Avocadoes (again, a special), since I thought I won't see something like it anywhere else ever again; so I felt like I had to try it. Aga successful shot, these grilled avocado halves with tuna tartar on top were super delicious and I will separately remember them as a part of my vacation."], ['116894725535672820749_60462ca110ec061e056b3f21', "I've tried half of the menu here - crepes, pancakes, wraps, skillets and never been disappointed with its quality. Last time I got very veggie skillet and yet, I haven't tried better."], ['116894725535672820749_6047e634b1a0aaee3eef94d6', "I got the Cuban sandwich and it was like 4 inch thick, a ton of fresh and delicious ingredients inside golden-brown toasted bread. Avocado toasts look like the food I'd like to eat every day, whoever came up with the idea of this combo is a genius. I got the Kiwi juice, that I never tasted before and it was just amazing, although a little too sweet; so if you're not into sugar thing, probably pick something else. The rest of the food was about average, Cuban sandwich $15, Avocado toasts with salmon $16, Kiwi Juice $6..."], ['116894725535672820749_6045dc193ed2666ae7ac1f0c', 'I like the idea of revolving sushi bars, thats quite awesome!'], ['116894725535672820749_60467fd8882f4d1caf5ff327', 'Lobster bisque indeed best in town and definitely worth trying! Although I did not have too much lobster ever before, Lobster Fiery Pasta gets 10 out of 10 from me.']]

review_text: Vast selections of meat and a huge salad bar. Some of the meats like beef, bacon, and lamb were really tasty and well seasoned.
history_reviews: [['106039788106377602384_60502ac22bb6034da9df9332', 'The Kung Pao Beef is original, though, its taste was sweeter than I could imagine.'], ['106039788106377602384_604aa12bc6dc737bce7e5c8b', 'The basket bread came with quality olive oil and parmesan cheese. When the pizza was out, which had meatballs, ricotta cheese, sliced garlic, fresh basil, marinara sauce, and string mozzarella, we had high hope for it.'], ['106039788106377602384_6041590b7cd8bf1303624d8e', 'But for that times, its Pho was one the worst I have ever had. The pork chop was poorly seasoned and sweet. Undoubtedly, there are places in Chicago where I found better Vietnamese food at a lower rate.'], ['106039788106377602384_60512909d8c08f462b93e2ae', 'My favorite was plain wings with Louisiana Rub and Lemon Pepper on the side, extra seasoning double crispy fried, and bleu cheese dip.'], ['106039788106377602384_6042d0edb9a6829e686eae7c', 'For the restaurant, I had Pan-Seared Red Snapper & Jumbo Sea Scallops, and my girlfriend had Lobster Carbonara. The scallops here merely is out-of-this-world. It came with steamed black jasmine rice and vegetables with a Spicy Thai Red Curry in Coconut Milk Sauce, making the whole meal well-balanced and mellow. I definitely will come back here to try their famous sushi.'], ['106039788106377602384_6046504710ec061e056b41b5', 'Really good food, wide selection of breakfast, many unique options such as glazed bacon (Million Dollar Bacon) or bite-sized donuts (Holey Donuts), solid taste of food and consistent quality of ingredients despite the locations.'], ['106039788106377602384_60545cf380c04bd7072f24ff', 'We ordered a dish of Koubideh with rice, Lamb Shank, and Hummus with pita bread. The kabob, a combination of ground beef and lamb and herbs as they said, was bland, harsh, and lack of juicy. The lamb shank was overly sweet, somehow. The lamb shank and the bulgur wheat did not make a right combination as a whole. I had no idea why they had not given us the lamb shank gravy, the best thing about it. The hummus and pita bread were pretty luscious, but they are not the best I have ever had.'], ['106039788106377602384_604251ba2e57ebdea29c9a3a', 'No one can ever go wrong with charbroiled-to-perfection oysters, one of the very few restaurants that served the oyster that way, and indeed it was the righteous way to prepare an oyster. All the buttery, garlicky, savory, smoky, and succulent from high quality oysters, and tangy from charred lemon delivered in one plate. Another delicious recipe which was grilled, tender, juiciness flank steak with chimichurri and creamy, silky mashed potato befitted a delectable entree. While the flourless chocolate torte served with raspberry and port wine reduction was earthy, chocolaty and fruity, the bruleed key lime pie-structured stack was smooth and citrusy.'], ['106039788106377602384_604161652e57ebdea29c3d93', "The restaurant celebrated the National Hot Dog Week by offering two hot dogs of all kinds for $5, which was pretty a bargain. The hot dog includes mustard, relish, celery salt, freshly chopped onions, sliced red ripe tomatoes, kosher pickle, and sport peppers piled onto a steamed poppy seed bun. The crinkle-cut french fries were quite tasty. But most delicious of all, the famous Portillo's Chocolate Cake was fluffy and daily made in each restaurant. Each double-layer chocolate cake was generously iced with two pounds of rich, chocolate frosting."], ['106039788106377602384_60415e8d7cd8bf13036250e4', 'Great donut. The donut is fluffy and freshly made every day. A warm donut stuffed with ice cream and hot chocolate sauce is incredible.'], ['106039788106377602384_60442cef02653670cedea912', 'Everything here was fresh, tasty, and authentic, from dim sum to soup to fried rice.'], ['106039788106377602384_604159ca2e57ebdea29c39a3', 'My friend and I ordered a bowl of Tonkotsu ramen and a bowl of Shiitake ramen. One thing worth to mention, there is bamboo shoot in both of our bowls but it was not shown on the menu, and unfortunately, I am not a fan of bamboo shoot. The molten egg, which was precisely brined in sake wine and soy sauce, was good. The chashu pork, shiitake were seasoned good, too. The noodle was nothing to complain about. The most important ingredient of a ramen bowl is the broth, and in Ramen-san, the taste of the traditional soup was thick and umami-rich. So that, the Tonkotsu ramen as a whole was solid as I had expected. However, the Shiitake ramen broth was too salty and too fatty to us. The chef also put some pieces of cold butter into the soup, making it much creamier than the one of some other ramen places we have tried. Additionally, the condiment has sesame oil and sesame seeds that people could try with the ramen, a very traditional style.'], ['106039788106377602384_6054c4e76204e8cd294f246f', 'Really good food, wide selection of breakfast, many unique options such as glazed bacon (Million Dollar Bacon) or bite-sized donuts (Holey Donuts), solid taste of food and consistent quality of ingredients despite the locations.']]

review_text: This place has one of the best bagels in Queens! I got a toasted everything bagel with lox spread. The first time was years ago, and I remember the bagel being good but too the lox spread was too salty. The bagel was just as good as I remember.

For dessert, I got the cold lychee in butterfly pea tea. The butterfly pea tea is a very pretty purple color. I definitely have to come back for one of their Thai ramen dishes, as that is what they're known for so I'm looking forward to my next visit for that."], ['100081839855053099906_605708d8d2ad6b7a67e27f2e', 'Came here for the free custard promo when they were having it through the app. The custard was good.'], ['100081839855053099906_605707bc8cd0e3d69a5226a9', 'I went with the Chaat Momo, which is fried momo dumplings in raita (yogurt sauce) and cilantro chutney, with onions, tomatoes, and onions.'], ['100081839855053099906_60545e504b7f30a9c0a50dc2', 'I had the menemen which is a scrambled eggs and tomatoes dish.'], ['100081839855053099906_605707e7c4674474cff9122d', 'This is a great hotpot place for vegetarians or pescetarians. We also got the spaghetti carbonara which was okay but could've been better. I felt that the sauce was missing something and the prosciutto made up for the flavor but it was too rich."], ['100081839855053099906_6057082cc4674474cff9122e', "This is an all you can eat sushi and seafood buffet. I was very happy with the variety in sushi and sashimi. The salmon was my favorite."], ['100081839855053099906_605708206fce2069470c60f3', "I came here for the chapulines tacos, which I've heard so much about, and they did not disappoint. The guac tasted fresh too."], ['100081839855053099906_6057086cd2ad6b7a67e27f2c', 'The sushi was good and they have happy hour specials where drinks and dessert are half price.'], ['100081839855053099906_605708238cd0e3d69a5226b6', "I ordered the hot pastrami sandwich. The egg and the noodles were full of flavor and very delicious.'], ['100081839855053099906_60570874c4674474cff91231', "It's certain pizza or pasta dishes, served with a side salad."], ['100081839855053099906_6057083cf69c7b11780702bd', "I had the bulgogi bibimbap in the hot stone bowl, but they have the option to have it serves cold, as well. I was hesitant about trying it because I've had lox in the past and I didn't like it, but the lox at Russ and Daughters was life-changing. It's quality lox that is savory and smooth, and doesn't have that weird artificial smoke flavor."], ['100081839855053099906_60545ebf80c04bd7072f2508', 'I ordered the vegetable dum biryani, whereas my friend was looking for something lighter, and less carby, so she ordered the paneer khurchan. It smelled amazing and the naan was beautifully cooked.'], ['100081839855053099906_6057080ad2ad6b7a67e27f2a', "I came here for their famous cacio e pepe. Well, at Cacio e Pepe, you'd be right! review_text: My friend and I ordered a bowl of Tonkotsu ramen and a bowl of Shiitake ramen. One thing worth to mention, there is bamboo shoot in both of our bowls but it was not shown on the menu, and unfortunately, I am not a fan of bamboo shoot. The molten egg, which was precisely brined in sake wine and soy sauce, was good. The chashu pork, shiitake were seasoned good, too. The noodle was nothing to complain about. The most important ingredient of a ramen bowl is the broth, and in Ramen-san, the taste of the traditional soup was thick and umami-rich. So that, the Tonkotsu ramen as a whole was solid as I had expected. However, the Shiitake ramen broth was too salty and too fatty to us. The chef also put some pieces of cold butter into the soup, making it much creamier than the one of some other ramen places we have tried. Additionally, the condiment has sesame oil and sesame seeds that people could try with the ramen, a very traditional style.

history_reviews: [['101150753919069824692_60497d0c1ec03878d66c7a20', "Food:. . I ordered their chicken karaage as a starter and their Hakata Tonkotsu DX.
